name: strategy-source-repro
cmd: mkdir -p recovery-input-source; cp source-recovery-input/* recovery-input-source/; mv recovery-input recovery-messages; mv recovery-input-source recovery-input; bun strategy-input/prepare.ts --export-part=0

name: native-canon-identity
cmd: mkdir -p recovery-input-source; cp source-recovery-input/* recovery-input-source/; mv recovery-input recovery-messages; mv recovery-input-source recovery-input; bun native-input/native-canon-check.ts

name: strategy-commitlint
cmd: set -euo pipefail; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli@19.8.1 @commitlint/config-conventional@19.8.1 >/dev/null); printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs"; for file in recovery-input/*COMMIT*.txt; do "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < "$file"; sha256sum "$file"; done
